properties.field_evidence: Official Cherwell District Council Planning Register application 26/02018/F. Status: Under Consultation. Location: Hall Farm 30 Spring Hill Road Begbroke Kidlington OX5 1RX. Proposal: Restoration of the Grade II listed cart shed comprising rebuilding of the collapsed section of the west stone wall, lime repointing, structural repairs and re-roofing in salvaged and matching stone slates; demolition of metal clad and timber structures; erection of a garden shed and a greenhouse; formation of a new stone wall and raised wall corner; widening of an existing opening and formation of new gates; parking, gravel surfacing and low level drive lighting. Valid Date: 03/08/2026. Decision and Decision Issued Date are blank on the register. Proposed Plans include Proposed South Site Plan/Details drawing 3500 P01-C dated 03/08/2026.
